Name: Legendary Fish Pond Framework (deprecated)
Author: sharpskull2
Description:
[size=5](DEPRECATED) This is now included in vanilla, So this mod is no longer needed for having legendary fish in fishponds[/size]

[size=3]This mod Legendary Fish Pond Framework makes it so that any item with the fish tag can be put into fish ponds. The main thing this affects is legendary fish, it bypasses the isLegalFishForPonds check in vanilla. This should work for any mod that adds legendary fish to the game as long as they have the fish tag. By default, if you don't have a mod installed that edits the FishPondData.xnb/json the legendary fish will only produce roe.[/size]

I made this mod to work in conjunction with my other mod [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13399](CP) Better Fish Ponds[/url] to allow legendary fish to produce additional drops.

[b]Manual Install[/b][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]
This mod should be compatible with most other mods
